attributes.name: Invigorating Kukri +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d4+1; you may additionally recharge this card to add another 2d4.

On your combat check, if you played another weapon, discard this card to add 1d4.

When a character at your location defeats a monster, recharge this card to recharge a random card from your discard pile.
